setup_sam_3d_body_estimator: create a SAM 3D Body estimator with optional human detector, segmentor, and FOV estimator components
setup_skeleton_visualizer: build a skeleton visualizer configured with MHR70 pose metadata for drawing 2D keypoints
visualize_2d_keypoints_and_bboxes: visualize 2D keypoints and bounding boxes overlaid on an image using a skeleton visualizer
visualize_3d_mesh_overlay: visualize 3D body mesh overlaid on the original image with front and side views
process_image_with_external_mask: process an image with an external mask input to compute 3D body pose estimation
